notes.title: CHRISTMAS UPDATE!
notes.notes:
Merry Christmas, guys!
How are your holidays going?

This time, we added new stuff to Little Briar Rose! :D
Together with it, we offer a [b]30% discount on both the Game and the OST+Artwork bundle[/b]! ✨

[h2]IMPROVEMENTS[/h2]

☆ [b]4 new original tracks[/b] have been added to Little Briar Rose! If you've purchased the OST+Artwork bundle, you'll now receive those new songs as well :)

☆ Improved Controller support: switching between controller and mouse controls is now super smooth and battle-tested!

[h2]BUGS[/h2]

☆ Unity update to 2017.4.35f1, featuring lots of bug fixes and macOS Catalina support

☆ Fixed a long-running bug on some Linux distros, causing the characters to walk in random directions

☆ Fixed a small bug when trying to walk while a character is starting to talk

☆ Fixed a couple of broken links within the game

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27005500/d8714dbc5c2ec9d25ab80f8bb9b1c7c0a442c071.png[/img]

That's all for this update!
Enjoy your Holidays and see you the next time!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27005500/707fb355dddca21d423b9bb40216b7d7204dcc6b.png[/img]

notes.title: #LOVEINDIES WEEK UPDATE
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27005500/1438d8aa88ac8ec513e23691078759252216b984.png[/img]

Hi there!

Little Briar Rose's team is joining the [url=https://twitter.com/search?src=typd&q=%23loveindies] #loveindies Week[/url] and we hope you're hyped to join too.
We are preparing some cool news about [b]Little Briar Rose[/b], which we'll reveal during this week, so stay tuned!

The [url=https://twitter.com/search?src=typd&q=%23loveindies] #loveindies Week[/url] aims to celebrate the indie community in its entirety.
This celebration wishes to shorten the distance between players and devs, encouraging you to express yourself and leave a review.

You might not know how much a simple review or rating can mean to an indie development team. They make a huge difference to us! We can learn and grow this way.
So, if you get the chance, please leave a review about Little Briar Rose!

Thank you for supporting indie games, we wouldn’t be able to do what we love without you!


[h1]First announcement:[/h1]
As a gift to the indie community and to help the game to spread around, we've decided to definitively change the price from 7.99$ to 4.99$. Little Briar Rose was our first project and we would love to see it played more and more!


[h1]Update on Localisation project[/h1]
Here's the progress about the community localisation project!
We can't contain our excitement! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27005500/cb56a794bd13d7371729889491a0f9545d70e610.jpg[/img]

Looks like Spanish is almost done! This is incredible guys, I'd like to give a big thank to all the translators <3



We'll see soon with another news!
Thank you very much for your support!

notes.title: SUMMER UPDATE + CALL FOR TRANSLATORS
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27005500/618b013c5abfaa0c3022e2d71f77e6b175c63cc8.png[/img]

Hi everyone,
What's up? Are you all enjoying the summer so far?

The team is glad to offer you a special 50% for the Steam Summer Sales.

The sales come with a couple of updates:

[h1]Call for Translators[/h1]
Little Briar Rose is a text-rich game. Quite text-rich actually! Maybe not the most text-rich game around, but we had quite some fun coming up with cool dialogues and funny jokes, painting a very unique dialogues style.
This, however, cut our legs short when we dreamed to open the game to more than English and Italian (our mother tongue).

Still, some of you reached out to us asking if they could translate the game for fun, so we've told ourselves: why don't we continue living the dream a bit before waking up?

Taking into consideration all this, we've worked on adapting the game: Little Briar Rose is now open to be translated from the community!

[b]But what should you do in practice?[/b]
Go to this link: http://translate.elfgamesworks.com/collaboration/project?id=300139
Select which language you want to translate it to (If your language is not listed, please report to us)
Create an account for free to start translating!

We have to warn you, though, princes: Our lovey-dovey game counts around 17k words. How cute, right?

As proof of your unyielding valor, any brave soul that will collaborate to this challenge will be automatically added to the game credits.
Thank you!


[h1]Discord Official Channel[/h1]

We remind you of our official discord channel, where you can reach us for the purpose just above, or for anything else related to the game.
https://discordapp.com/invite/elfgames

Come and have fun! ^ ^

[h1]Today's Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Update to Unity 2017.3.1
[*] Preparing the game for multiple localizations
[*] Fix wrong achievement description
[*] Simplified main menu, removing useless elements
[*] Now you can open/close the menu with Esc
[*] Replaced a few sound effects with softer ones
[*] Fix attempt for Linux users (We'd like to receive feedback on this)
[/list]

notes.title: Update and Backstage
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27005500/618b013c5abfaa0c3022e2d71f77e6b175c63cc8.png[/img]

Hello everyone,
It’s been a while!
Did you miss us? We hope so!
We are still working hard to improve the game from your feedbacks, but there were also a lot of interesting news for our team.

However, let’s start from the beginning! Here is a list of changes we introduced in this release:


[h1]Changelist[/h1]
[list]
[*] The intro will now restart after idling for more than 30 seconds in the Title 

[*] Minor audio bug-fix while building the house

[*] Fixed the camera that occasionally froze in the Castle Map

[*] Fixed a bug where the Princess' room song wasn't starting after loading a save

[*] Unity upgrade to 5.5.2

[*] Fixed a few English typos

[*] Fixed a bug with a fairy sprite that wasn't showing properly on game load

[*] Gameplay improvement of gnome costume scene: It's now possible to change items before going to the Merman. As some users pointed out, that missing choice was pedantic and unnecessary.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27005500/a5e319b6fd301c9202d4a3044960e4446a7fcd47.png[/img]
[/list]


[h1]Mayor Known Issue: Fishing[/h1]
The Fishing Game has officially won the "most-hated" minigame award in Little Briar Rose.
We received many negative feedbacks about that part, so we are working to rebuild it entirely, introducing some new and enjoying mechanics to improve flawed design choices.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27005500/6371bdad733483b03d57ad0b8fd5c3fdf4683690.png[/img]


[h1]Little Briar Rose making-of[/h1]
Our artist started a short blog-post series that explains how she achieved the stained-glass art style of Little Briar Rose.
You can find the first part here:

http://www.elfgamesworks.com/short?to=howto-stained-glass-game-inspirations


[h1]Best Game Design Award for Little Briar Rose[/h1]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27005500/ade1628b3fb8e6d5aaad800f8758e7977a93337e.jpg[/img]
This month has been an exciting and important month for us. Our game has been nominated in all four categories of Premio Drago d’Oro, an Italian video games award.
We were, and are, astonished by this local, yet significative news. Finally, last week the final event took place and our game won the Best Game Design Award.

We are happy and willing to challenge the bigger world, with this and new projects we are developing, since this is the beginning of a journey we will take.
We would say thanks to all our players that helped us with constructive feedback and support.
Thanks!


The news is now over. Thanks for reading this slightly different news!

Don't forget to follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/BriarRoseGame]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://www.facebook.com/LittleBriarRoseGame/]Facebook[/url] for some small preview that will be released in the next days!

See you in the next update!

notes.title: Little Briar Rose gets its first update
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27005500/7d335dd92e44309928de3c9fa6cd7f31c09815b1.png[/img]

Hello there!

For those who follow us on [url=http://www.facebook.com/LittleBriarRoseGame]Facebook[/url] and [url=http://www.twitter.com/BriarRoseGame]Twitter[/url], you may have noticed that we are working on something special for the Holiday Season. Absolutely so!

[url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27005500/707fb355dddca21d423b9bb40216b7d7204dcc6b.png][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27005500/410aa92fdfb84cbf9194599c4c40a1916b4801c1.png[/img][/url]


Meanwhile, here are a few fixes:

Bug fix:
[list]
    [*] Fixed typos in dialogues.
    [*] Disabled the resolution windows on game startup.
    [*] Partially fixed wrong roads in the maze minigame.
    [*] Fixed a bug with sound effects.
    [*] Removed the "Account" menu (left by mistake)
[/list]


In progress (Known bugs):
[list]
    [*] Beggar achievement won't unlock: Fix planned for the next update
    [*] Maze roads may be broken: currently working on this.
[/list]


Coming soon:
[list]
    [*] Steam Cloud sync
    [*] Steam Workshop
[/list]

A new update is upcoming in the next few days!

Thank you for your support! It means a lot :)
